newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Peaceful poll, Dow rise, boost Manila stocks.
newsitem.headline: Peaceful poll, Dow rise, boost Manila stocks.

text.p: * Manila shares up 1.12 percent or 35.38 points
Manila shares ended higher on Tuesday as investors cheered the peaceful elections in Mindanao and the steep rise of the Dow Jones overnight, brokers said.
The composite index jumped by 35.38 points, or 1.12 percent at 3,201.80 ending a five-day losing streak.

"There was a slight rally because of the rise in the Dow Jones index and the effect of quiet elections in Mindanao," said Lippo Securities trader Rudsend Alpay, referring to Monday's polling for a semi-autonomous Moslem regional government in the southern Philippines.
Manila's composite index rose by 35.38 points, or 1.12 percent, to close at 3,201.80 points.
Traders said the market will move sideways for the rest of the week as they continue to await news on U.S. interest rates.
